summary: Every round-1 issue is fixed. The one-time scenes play once, the repeat cards have neutral again-lines keyed on their own `seen()`, the decline options now gain something, every variant shows its cost, Vey's check is against Vey, and Pell is seventy-seven. One continuity slip is new: the satchel card's new right option sends you to a lecture at an afternoon or evening lakeshore visit, which can also fall on a break. That, and three polish items, are small fixes.

issues.problem: The new right option ('Leave it to her and get to class'; says: 'you were in your lecture', 'make your lecture') doesn't fit when the card can show. It is a lakeshore place card, dealt only on afternoon or evening visits, while courses are the morning slot. The gate is only `season != "winter"`, so it can also show on a break (months 5, 6, 11 and 12), when there are no lectures.
issues.fix: Add `term` to `when`. Recast the right option as going back to your own work rather than a lecture (e.g. 'Leave it to her and go and revise'; 'you're at your desk with your notes dry'), keeping `study +tiny`.

issues.problem: Polish. Right say variant 2 (he hands you the wrong book, which has exactly the chapter you needed) reads as a gift and doesn't show the option's `rel grimsby -tiny`. Variants 1 ('a little lost') and 3 do show it.
issues.fix: Add a beat of his disappointment to variant 2 (e.g. '...and goes back to squinting at his own page, a little crestfallen').

issues.problem: Polish. The left label 'Hold the lantern till the lake stills' is 37 characters.
issues.fix: Shorten it, e.g. 'Hold the lantern up for her'.

issues.problem: Polish, wiring. The `seen(<own id>) == 0` added to `when` here and in `mabel_empty_hook`, `grimsby_lighthouse_walk` and `brask_laugh` is redundant: without `repeat:` a card already plays once per game.
issues.fix: Optionally drop the `seen(...) == 0` clause from those four `when` lines. It does no harm, so this is only tidying.
